words.gloss_range: disconnected rhetorical question particle; here it renews the challenge rather than offering a neutral alternative
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْ}} ({{tr:am}}) opens a fresh rhetorical test: it carries rebuttal and interrogation together, so the following claim is being challenged rather than calmly queried. Its ayah-initial placement makes the whole line another member of the 52:30-43 question barrage, and its final nasal sound lightly anticipates the plural group that will be challenged next.

topics.headline: disconnected challenge particle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the question as rebuttal plus interrogation, not as a neutral request for information.
topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:أَمْ}} ({{tr:am}}) as disconnected interrogative, and the attachment notes preserve the repeated rhetorical-question force.

topics.headline: same-surah question-chain restart
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this ayah as one renewed strike in the 52:30-43 sequence rather than an isolated topic shift.
topics.reason: The row family and attachment evidence both mark a recurring question-chain pattern in 52:30-43.

topics.headline: nasal sound anticipates the challenged group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can notice a small sound cue that ties the opening particle to the plural opponents before the syntax fully unfolds.
topics.reason: The sound row is not contradicted by grammar; it remains a modest phonetic payoff rather than a semantic claim.

words.gloss_range: with them, at them, in their possession, or within their access; local grammar makes it the fronted predicate of the unseen-possession question
words.root_gloss_range: the locally selected branch is proximity and presence; other root branches such as stubborn opposition are only background comparisons when explicitly row-supported
words.prose: {{ar:عِندَهُمُ}} ({{tr:ʿindahumu}}) puts 'with them' before the unseen, making the possessors themselves the contested location. The word does not use formal ownership terminology; it stages proximity, presence, possession, and access as one pressure point, while the attached plural suffix binds the claim to the same unnamed group. The root background of {{ar:ع ن د}} ({{tr:ʿ-n-d}}) can add irony through stubborn opposition, but the local sense remains the adverbial proximity branch. Its recurrence in possession frames (52:37) and the exact formula (68:47) make this a repeated access test, not a one-off wording; the paired ending with the following subject also lets predicate and subject land as one challenged unit.

topics.headline: fronted access predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah tests the impossible location 'with them' before even naming the unseen.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as an adverbial fronted predicate, with the unseen as delayed subject.

topics.headline: attached plural possessor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the claim is pinned to the recurring plural group instead of floating as an abstract possibility.
topics.reason: The suffix is syntactically forced and discourse-linked to the recurring third-person opponents.

topics.headline: access rather than formal ownership wording
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the spatial nearness image while avoiding an over-specific legal ownership reading.
topics.reason: The local form is an adverbial proximity expression, so possession and access are live, but formal ownership nouns are not selected.

topics.headline: stubbornness as background irony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may hear an ironic root-family backdrop: those in opposition are asked whether the hidden domain is somehow near them.
topics.reason: V4 supports a separate opposition branch for {{ar:ع ن د}} ({{tr:ʿ-n-d}}), but local grammar selects the proximity adverb, so the opposition branch can only function as background irony.

topics.headline: formulaic possession-access frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the word as part of a repeated possession-test frame, especially against claims to divine knowledge or authority.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-surah and cross-surah parallels: possession frames in 52:37 and the exact formula in 68:47.

topics.headline: paired cadence with the unseen
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear predicate and subject paired as one challenged unit, not as loosely connected terms.
topics.reason: The cadence row is compatible with the predicate-subject attachment and remains a modest sound-level observation.

words.gloss_range: the unseen or hidden domain, definite and singular here; locally the delayed subject of the possession premise, not the expressed object of writing
words.root_gloss_range: hiddenness, absence from perception or knowledge, and depth of concealment; causative hiding and other branches are not the local form
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْغَيْبُ}} ({{tr:al-ghaybu}}) arrives after the fronted predicate as the delayed subject, so the reader first hears the impossible 'with them' and then the hidden domain allegedly located there. Its nominative role keeps it as the possessed premise, while the object of the later writing remains unstated. As a definite singular verbal noun, it names the recognized unseen domain, not scattered hidden items or absent persons. The root {{ar:غ ي ب}} ({{tr:gh-y-b}}) preserves absence from perception and a depth-image of concealment; the joined recitation and closed sound texture make the predicate-subject unit feel continuous yet sealed. That makes possession and writing from it paradoxical, especially beside the access frame in 52:37, the belief contrast in 2:3, and the exact formula in 68:47, as the boundary shifts from financial burden to hidden knowledge.

topics.headline: delayed subject, not written object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unseen is the premise allegedly possessed, while what they write is left open later.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as nominative delayed subject of the nominal sentence, not as an accusative object.

topics.headline: definite singular unseen domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a recognized domain under challenge, not one hidden object or a list of hidden things.
topics.reason: The local form is definite, singular, and tagged as a gerund or verbal noun.

topics.headline: hiddenness and depth, not nonexistence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the challenge as about inaccessible knowledge that exists beyond perception, not about whether the unseen is real.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports hiddenness and depth images, while the local noun form blocks causative hiding as the active local sense.

topics.headline: access and writing paradox
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why possession of the hidden domain would be the necessary but impossible premise for authoritative writing.
topics.reason: The local syntax links the possession premise to the writing consequence, and the rows supply the exact 68:47 echo.

topics.headline: belief versus possession contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same domain can be approached by belief (2:3), but here the opponents are challenged for an impossible possession claim.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete contrasts with 2:3 and 52:37, so the inter-ayah payoff is retained with references.

topics.headline: sound and boundary shift into hidden knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and tracks the transition from the prior financial burden challenge into an epistemic-access challenge.
topics.reason: The boundary and sound rows do not govern the parse, but they preserve a real local transition and acoustic payoff.

topics.headline: broad cooccurrence background already covered
topics.reason: The broad cooccurrence note adds no distinct payoff beyond the retained access-writing paradox.

words.gloss_range: resultative or consequential particle; here it binds the writing clause to the prior possession premise inside the rhetorical question
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from premise to consequence: if the unseen were with them, then they would be writing. Because the hinge sits inside the rhetorical question, it does not assert their writing; it exposes the consequence as absurd and therefore undermines the premise. Its short proclitic form makes the turn quick, fuses the consequent link to the explicit pronoun that follows, and matches the adjacent consequence-clause pattern.

topics.headline: resultative hinge from premise to consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second clause as the logical consequence of the unseen-possession premise, not a separate accusation.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both mark the particle as resultative, linking the writing clause to the possession clause.

topics.headline: absurd consequence inside the question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands that the consequence is staged to deny the premise rather than to report an action.
topics.reason: The particle is governed by the disconnected rhetorical question, so its consequence remains part of the challenge.

topics.headline: proclitic speed and repeated boundary shape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears an immediate turn into the consequent subject slot, matching the adjacent challenge pattern.
topics.reason: The particle is attached as a proclitic and the boundary rows identify a repeated consequence-clause template across 52:40-41.

words.gloss_range: independent third-person masculine plural pronoun; here it explicitly foregrounds the same challenged group as the agents of the consequence clause
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) makes the agents visible before the verb even though the verb already carries plural marking. The consequence is therefore not just 'writing happens'; it is they themselves who are put under trial as writers. The independent pronoun also continues the unnamed plural target from the surrounding 52:30-43 question chain and links the possessor suffix, explicit subject, and verb ending into one challenged group, with a nasal thread carrying possession into action.

topics.headline: explicit agent foregrounding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the agents are stressed as the issue, not merely implied by verbal morphology.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence identifies the independent pronoun as the explicit subject of the following verb, despite the verb's own agreement marking.

topics.headline: recurring unnamed target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the challenge as portable to the recurring claimant class, because the opponents are continued but not named.
topics.reason: The cross-reference evidence resolves the pronoun to the same discourse group while preserving the unnamed surface.

topics.headline: sound and repeated consequent slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the plural group carried from possession into consequence as part of the repeated boundary template.
topics.reason: The sound and boundary rows are compatible with the explicit subject relation and add a modest local payoff.

words.gloss_range: they write, record, prescribe, or decree; locally an active imperfect Form I verb with no expressed object
words.root_gloss_range: joining letters into writing, producing a written record, and inscribing as binding prescription or decree; joining imagery remains a supporting root image, not an independent local action
words.prose: {{ar:يَكْتُبُونَ}} ({{tr:yaktubūna}}) closes the ayah on the alleged act: active, imperfect, plural writing by the very group just foregrounded. Because no object is expressed, the challenge stays broad: what exactly are they writing from the unseen, records, decrees, or claims? The root {{ar:ك ت ب}} ({{tr:k-t-b}}) lets writing, recording, and prescribing remain available together, with the older joining/inscription image sharpening the impossibility of binding hidden knowledge into an authoritative record. Form I makes the act direct rather than a 25:5-style caused copying, and the echoes with 52:2, 52:37, and 68:47 turn the final verb into a pointed reversal of true written authority. As the closing word, it also flips the boundary from a group burdened in 52:40 to the same group imagined as active writers here.

topics.headline: active ongoing plural agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opponents challenged as ongoing active writers, not as passive recipients or unnamed agents.
topics.reason: QAC and verb-instance evidence mark the verb as active imperfect third-person masculine plural, with the explicit pronoun as subject.

topics.headline: unexpressed object broadens the claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader is left to feel the open scope of the alleged writing rather than having it narrowed to one object.
topics.reason: The local verb instance has frame object status none_absolute, and the contextual valency profile confirms such objectless frames occur for this exact form class.

topics.headline: writing, decreeing, and inscription pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the act as self-authorized inscription of hidden knowledge, with both record-making and decree-making pressure.
topics.reason: V4 supports writing and binding-decree branches for {{ar:ك ت ب}} ({{tr:k-t-b}}), while local Form I and the unseen pairing keep the payoff centered on direct writing or prescribing, not every root branch.

topics.headline: direct Form I writing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the challenged claim is immediate and self-authorizing, not mediated by having someone else copy for them.
topics.reason: The local form is Form I, and the rows explicitly contrast it with the Form VIII copying accusation at 25:5.

topics.headline: textual root inverted against false writing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the irony that a major Quranic writing/scripture root is used here to expose unauthorized writing.
topics.reason: The exact local verb remains the controlling evidence; broad root frequency is retained only as a distributional irony.

topics.headline: intertextual writing-the-unseen network
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final verb as part of a larger pattern: possession, unseen knowledge, and writing authority are being tested together.
topics.reason: The rows supply concrete links to 52:2, 52:37, and 68:47, plus the local writing-unseen paradox.

topics.headline: closing action and boundary reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah land on the absurd action while the boundary flips the group from burdened recipients to alleged sovereign writers.
topics.reason: The verb is final, follows the explicit subject, completes the consequence clause, and the boundary rows tie that closure to the prior ayah's reversal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The locative possession in `indahum al-ghayb` is followed by the consequential `fa-hum yaktubun`.
baseline_models.mechanism: Proximity turns the unseen from a topic into an alleged source present to them; ordinary writing then appears as downstream transcription whose authority depends on that custody.

activation_trace.role: Concrete proximity supplies the alleged custody expressed by 'with them'.
Concealment from sight or knowledge supplies the inaccessible source that custody would have to overcome.
Ordered letters and a written product make their activity a claimed transcription of that source.

changed_reading.before: A generic denial that they know future facts.
changed_reading.after: A provenance question: is hidden reality actually present in their custody, so that their writing can count as transcription rather than assertion?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The omitted object of `yaktubun` leaves writing open to its prescriptive sense after possession of the unseen.
baseline_models.mechanism: If writing can establish a binding judgment or measure, the causal sequence tests not just information access but jurisdiction: possession of hidden order would be the supposed warrant for fixing outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Presence and possession provide the alleged standing from which a decree could issue.
The hidden order is the domain over which their claimed jurisdiction would extend.
Binding inscription changes writing from notation into the act of fixing judgment or destiny.

changed_reading.before: They merely write down what is unknown to others.
changed_reading.after: Do they possess hidden order and therefore claim standing to prescribe or fix what will occur?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins an inaccessible source to an act whose root can foreground joining components.
baseline_models.mechanism: Writing is treated as assembly rather than passive copying. The question therefore tests whether their textual construction has genuine hidden source material or only components they have joined into a claim.

activation_trace.role: Proximity asks whether the source-material is truly available for use.
Hiddenness marks the missing material that their construction purports to contain.
Joining one element to another supplies the compositional mechanics of making a textual claim.

changed_reading.before: The verse questions their ability to write hidden information.
changed_reading.after: The verse questions the source integrity of an assembled account: possession must precede composition, or the result is fabrication.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Because no object is stated for `yaktubun`, the register-and-enrollment branch remains grammatically available.
baseline_models.mechanism: Possessing the unseen would make them imagined administrators of a hidden roll, able to enter names or statuses rather than simply record propositions.

activation_trace.role: Having something in one's presence supplies custody of the imagined roll.
Hiddenness makes the roll inaccessible to ordinary verification.

strongest_changes: 52:37-38 expands the focus into a custody-access-reception-evidence pipeline whose final writing cannot authenticate itself.
52:30-31 activates writing as the hardening of uncertain forecast into pseudo-decree.

summary.what_was_special: The same short question sustained coexisting transcriptional, compositional, prescriptive, and registrarial readings. Local context did not select one: it supplied distinct tests of prediction, authorship, provenance, accounting, plotting, classification, and judgment, while branch-distant legal, generative, and split-root readings remained containable rather than disposable.
remaining_uncertainties: The object of yaktubun is unstated, so transcription, decree, registration, and contract cannot be finally ranked.
The consequential fa may voice their claimed inference, mock an impossible entailment, or simply advance the rhetorical question.
The access chain in 52:37-38 may intentionally stage a single provenance pipeline, or it may list separate impossible privileges.
The register, manumission, hidden-root, and non-dominant report activations are packet-anchored but remain form- or domain-distant.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin gözden veya duyudan saklı kalması, bulunduğu yerde hazır olmaması ya da insanın bilgisi dışında bulunmasıdır. Güneşin gözden çekilmesi ve bir kişinin ortamda bulunmaması bu çekirdeğin gerçekleşmeleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişinin adını pay veya geçim kaydına ya da yönetim siciline geçirmek ile kişiyi tanıklar topluluğuna dâhil etmek arasında ortak bir kayıt ve üyelik çekirdeği kurar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, genel yazma eylemini değil, adı kayda geçirerek kişiyi bir listeye veya belirli topluluğa dâhil etmeyi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Sicile alma ve topluluğa katma çekirdeği korunur; pay kaydı, yönetim sicili ve tanıklar arasına katılma anlamları kendi tanıklanmış yapılarıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin adını resmî bir pay, geçim veya yönetim kaydına geçirerek onu kayıtlılar arasına almak ya da kişiyi belirli bir topluluğun üyesi saymaktır.

facets.statement: Kişinin adını bir kayıt veya listeye geçirerek ona kayıtlı kişi konumu vermek dalın çekirdeğidir.
Adı pay, geçim tahsisatı veya yönetim siciline yazdırmak resmî kayıt alanındaki özel gerçekleşmedir.
Bir kişiyi tanıklar gibi belirli bir topluluğun içinde saymak, sicile almadan üyelik vermeye uzanan kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak içeriği, adı kayda geçirmenin kişiyi pay alanlar, yönetim sicilindekiler veya belirli bir topluluğun üyeleri arasına sokmasıdır.

concept_gloss.text: adını sicile yazma veya bir gruba dâhil etme
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem resmî sicile alma hem de kişiyi belirli bir topluluğun üyesi sayma anlamlarını kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Adı sicile yazma veya kişiye belirli bir topluluk içinde üyelik verme işlemlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin pay, geçim tahsisatı veya yönetim kaydına kendi adını geçirdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin adını resmî kayda geçirerek kayıtlı konum kazanması anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin tanıklar gibi adı belirli bir topluluğun üyesi sayıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye belirli topluluk içinde üyelik ve yer verilmesi anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırıcı özelliği adın kayda geçirilmesi veya üyelik verilmesidir; komşu dalda kayıt koşulu bulunmaz ve birleştirme kendi başına çekirdektir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, kişiyi adını kaydederek bir sicile veya topluluğa dâhil etme işlemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir şeyin belirli kişi veya topluluğa özel olmasını ve başkalarından ayrılmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kişi veya şeyin belirli bir toplulukla ilişkili konum kazanması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal katılma ve kayıt işlemini, komşu dal ise başkalarına kapalı özel aidiyet ve ayrışma durumunu merkez alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, köleleştirilmiş kişinin kendi özgürlük bedelini kazancından ve belirlenmiş ödemelerle karşılaması için sahibiyle yaptığı özel sözleşmeyi, taraflarını ve özgürleşme sonucunu açıkça tanımlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, her türlü yazılı sözleşmeyi değil, bedelin ödenmesiyle özgürlüğe götüren bu özel sözleşme türünü kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım özel sözleşme türüne bağlı kalır; sözleşmenin adı, tarafı ve sözleşme yapma eylemi ayrı tanıklanmış biçimler olarak korunur ve genel sözleşme anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Köleleştirilmiş kişinin, belirlenen bedeli kazancından ve kararlaştırılmış ödemelerle sahibine vererek özgürlüğünü kazanması için taraflar arasında yapılan özel sözleşmedir. Bedel tamamlandığında kişi özgür olur.

facets.statement: Sahip ile köleleştirilmiş kişi arasında, kişinin kendi özgürlük bedelini ödemesini konu alan özel bir sözleşme kurulur.
Bedel belirlenmiş ödeme dilimlerine bağlanır ve köleleştirilmiş kişi bunu kendi kazancından karşılar.
Kararlaştırılan bedelin tamamlanması sözleşmenin sonucu olarak köleleştirilmiş kişinin özgür olmasını sağlar.
İlgili biçimler sözleşmenin kendisini, sözleşmeye bağlı köleleştirilmiş kişiyi ve bağlama göre sözleşmenin öteki tarafını gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, özgürlük bedelinin kararlaştırılıp ödemelere bölündüğü, köleleştirilmiş kişinin bunu kazancıyla ödediği ve tamamlandığında özgürleştiği özel sözleşmede birleşir.

error_profile.preserves: Özel sözleşme türünü, bedel ödeme koşulunu ve özgürleşme sonucunu eksiksiz korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı özgürlük bedelinin ödenmesi ve kölelikten çıkma sürecinde yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hukuki ilişkiyi ve ödeme yükümlülüğünü kurar; komşu dal ise bu yükümlülüğü yerine getirmek için gösterilen çalışma ve kazanç sürecidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, özgürlüğün ancak kararlaştırılan bedelin sözleşmeye göre ödenmesiyle kazanılmasını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, sözleşme veya bedel koşulu aramadan özgür olma ve kölelikten çıkarılma durumunu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kölelik durumunun sona ermesi ve kişinin özgürlüğe kavuşması sonucunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Özgürlük komşu dalın doğrudan çekirdeğidir; odak dalda ise özel bir sözleşme ve bedelin ödenmesiyle ulaşılan sonuçtur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda özgürleşme, sahibin ölümünden sonra gerçekleşmek üzere önceden verilmiş karara bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal özgürlüğün gelecekteki bir koşul gerçekleşince doğmasını düzenler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın koşulu bedelin sözleşmeye göre ödenmesidir; komşu dalın koşulu ise sahibin ölümü olup ödeme sözleşmesi bulunmaz.
